title: How can I pass another hit attribute field into onchange not the selected value

comments.body: Can you please replicate your example in this [InstantSearch.js sandbox](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js) so we better understand what you're expecting?

Hi there what I'm trying to do is a simple select dropdown. 

I have list of website names they can choose from.  When the user selects one I want it do redirect to the website url. ( an attribute field)

Currently Im just getting the text value of the selected option. 

https://codesandbox.io/s/great-haze-mm88y

This is actually a selectize question, not related to InstantSearch, but you can do it like this: https://codesandbox.io/s/funny-wildflower-x3u79?file=/src/app.js

You have to read `selectize.options[value]` to get to the "raw" option, which has the URL

(edited your sandbox to actually work, you forgot some jquery parts)

relevant selectize option: https://github.com/selectize/selectize.js/issues/699
